nodes.label: Big-O Analysis
nodes.description: Measure how running time and memory grow with input size. The language used to compare every algorithm that follows.

nodes.label: Arrays
nodes.description: Contiguous memory, indexing, traversal, insertion and deletion costs, and 2D arrays.

nodes.label: Strings
nodes.description: String manipulation, immutability, palindromes, anagrams and basic pattern matching.

nodes.label: Recursion
nodes.description: Functions that call themselves: base case, recursive case, call stack and recurrence relations.

nodes.label: Basic Sorting
nodes.description: Bubble, selection and insertion sort. Stability, in-place sorting and O(n^2) behaviour.

nodes.label: Binary Search
nodes.description: Halve the search space each step on sorted data, including search-on-answer variants.

nodes.label: Linked Lists
nodes.description: Nodes and pointers, singly and doubly linked lists, reversal, and fast/slow pointers.

nodes.label: Stacks
nodes.description: LIFO structure: balanced brackets, expression evaluation, monotonic stack.

nodes.label: Queues
nodes.description: FIFO structure: circular queue, deque, and the building block for BFS.

nodes.label: Hashing
nodes.description: Hash functions, collisions, chaining, open addressing; dictionaries and sets.

nodes.label: Two Pointers & Sliding Window
nodes.description: Solve contiguous subarray/substring problems in O(n) using moving boundaries.

nodes.label: Merge & Quick Sort
nodes.description: Divide-and-conquer sorting in O(n log n). Partitioning, merging and pivot choice.

nodes.label: Binary Trees
nodes.description: Hierarchical data: inorder/preorder/postorder, level order, height and diameter.

nodes.label: Binary Search Trees
nodes.description: Ordered trees with O(h) search/insert/delete. Introduction to balancing (AVL).

nodes.label: Heaps & Priority Queues
nodes.description: Complete binary trees in arrays, heapify, heap sort, top-K problems.

nodes.label: Tries
nodes.description: Prefix trees for autocomplete, dictionary lookups and word search.

nodes.label: Graph Basics
nodes.description: Vertices and edges, directed/undirected, weighted graphs, adjacency list vs matrix.

nodes.label: BFS & DFS
nodes.description: Breadth-first and depth-first traversal, connected components, cycle detection, grid problems.

nodes.label: Backtracking
nodes.description: Explore all choices and undo bad ones: subsets, permutations, N-Queens, Sudoku.

nodes.label: Greedy Algorithms
nodes.description: Locally optimal choices that lead to a global optimum: interval scheduling, coin change (special cases).

nodes.label: Dynamic Programming
nodes.description: Overlapping subproblems and optimal substructure: memoization, tabulation, 1D DP.

nodes.label: Shortest Paths (Dijkstra)
nodes.description: Single-source shortest paths in graphs with non-negative weights using a priority queue.

nodes.label: Union-Find (DSU)
nodes.description: Disjoint sets with path compression and union by rank for connectivity queries.

nodes.label: Minimum Spanning Tree
nodes.description: Kruskal's and Prim's algorithms for connecting all vertices at minimum total cost.

nodes.label: Topological Sort
nodes.description: Linear ordering of a DAG: Kahn's algorithm and DFS-based ordering; task scheduling.

nodes.label: Advanced DP
nodes.description: 2D DP: knapsack, LCS, edit distance, DP on grids, bitmask DP intro.
